src/boot/rpi5.rs: retains FDT /chosen firmware initrd bounds during the DTB phase
threads firmware_initrd into plan_boot_memory before page-frame seeding and translation-table layout
src/memory_map/layout.rs: adds optional FdtInitrdRange exclusion to conservative_low_memory_candidate
page-rounds initrd.start..initrd.end with EARLY_USABLE_ALIGNMENT before exclusion
returns unavailable candidate if the exclusion exhausts the low-tail bank
src/memory_map/page_frames.rs: updates existing consumer tests to pass no firmware-initrd exclusion

findings.finding: Pi 5 boot-memory planning now excludes present firmware initrd bounds before early allocation ownership.
Exclusion is page-rounded so no page intersecting firmware initrd bytes is selected as early usable memory.
Focused tests cover the accepted blocker range and the exhausted low-tail failure path.
Generated-root artifact parser and compiled fallback behavior required no source change.
Pi 5 generated-root consumption proof remains a serialized hardware task.
Hardware proof, boot publication, persistence, SD/USB/block drivers, networking, SSH, Phase 11/12 work, and phase transition claims are outside this task.
